subject: Unit economics deep-dive / follow-up — $/1M tokens, $/feature, CAC payback
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@acmetech.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + unit-econ inputs you promised

Thanks again for the call this morning, Jorge — appreciate the time and the clear signal on what success looks like for Acme. Per promised follow-up, short recap of what we heard + the inputs we need to finish a concise unit-economics proposal and pilot quote.

Key items from the call (as I heard them):
- Primary product flows: interactive chat (customer support triage), weekly batch summaries (internal ops), and search/rerank for knowledge base.
- Expected activity: ~25k MAUs in year 1, average 3 sessions/user/month, ~120 tokens/session (prompt + response) for chat.
- Embeddings for search: ~10M embeddings generated initially, then incremental monthly growth.
- Target procurement timeline: pilot in 30 days, decision on paid deployment in 90 days.
- Budget guidance you mentioned: mid-five-figures/month target for year-one run-rate (you said $40k–$75k/mo range).

What we need from you (can reply inline):
1) Confirm the activity profile above (MAU, sessions/user/month, tokens/session) or provide corrected numbers.
2) For features, confirm which will be paid product features vs experimental: chat (yes), search/rerank (yes), summaries (MVP first, paid later).
3) Any constraints from procurement on unit economics — e.g., target $/1M tokens acceptable to finance? You mentioned wanting a target around $25–$40 per 1M tokens earlier; we want to be explicit on the target so we can model margins.

Next steps from our side once we have your confirmation:
- We’ll produce 2 pricing scenarios (Conservative: 50% caching + standard batching; Optimized: prefix caching + quantized model profile) with $/1M token ranges and per-feature $/call estimates.
- A short 4-week pilot quote with a refundable credit structure to validate latency and cost run-rate.
- A simple CAC payback model showing expected payback months at different ARPU assumptions (helpful for your CFO).

I’ve attached a starter pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx) with placeholders — we’ll fill in after your confirmation. Looping in Logan (AE) and Vivek (Solutions) who'll be on the pilot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@acmetech.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acmetech.ai
Date: 2026-02-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + unit-econ inputs you promised

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers and answering inline: 

> - Primary product flows: interactive chat (customer support triage), weekly batch summaries (internal ops), and search/rerank for knowledge base.
Confirmed. Chat will be the high-volume feature, search/rerank is gold-level for power users.

> - Expected activity: ~25k MAUs in year 1, average 3 sessions/user/month, ~120 tokens/session (prompt + response) for chat.
Numbers look right; token/session might be on the high side for short triage flows — can we model 90–120 tokens/session as a sensitivity?

> - Embeddings for search: ~10M embeddings generated initially, then incremental monthly growth.
Yes, initial ingest ~10M, then ~200k new embeddings/month after month 1.

> - Budget guidance you mentioned: mid-five-figures/month target for year-one run-rate (you said $40k–$75k/mo range).
Finance note: our procurement would prefer a target effective inference cost at or below $30 per 1M tokens to hit margin targets. If you can get close to $25/1M with caching/batching, that would be ideal. However, if $/feature pricing or committed throughput changes the math we’re open.

Other notes from finance:
- CAC payback: target is <9 months for the feature bundle (chat + search).
- Margin target: gross margin at least 65% after inference cost (we'll absorb sales/hosting costs separately).

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you provide a per-feature $/call estimate (chat avg session, search rerank per query, summary per doc) under both Conservative and Optimized scenarios?
2) If we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity (dedicated pool), what’s the improvement vs hosted API on $/1M tokens? Provide delta in $/1M tokens and expected latency SLOs.

Happy to jump on another quick call tomorrow if that helps. Jorge
Jorge Alvarez
Head of Product | Acme Analytics
jorge@acmetech.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@acmetech.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, finance@acmetech.ai
Date: 2026-02-13T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unit economics — initial numbers + next steps

Great, Jorge — thank you for the clarity. Below is an initial, conservative unit-econ sketch we can put into the workbook and the pilot quote. This is intentionally simple so finance can see the levers. We’ll follow up with a filled workbook and a short one-page summary for your CFO.

High-level: we show three deployment/pricing rows — Hosted (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated (12mo commit, reserved GPUs), and Optimized Pilot (small reserved + caching + quantization). All $/1M numbers are inclusive of inference runtime and tokenization overhead but exclude storage/ingest costs.

Conservative estimates (per 1M tokens):
- Hosted API (baseline): $68 / 1M tokens
- Dedicated 12mo commit: $36 / 1M tokens (approx -47% vs hosted)
- Optimized Pilot (quant+prefix cache): $24 / 1M tokens (best-effort; depends on model and hit-rate)

Per-feature (per call) examples — assume chat session = 3 calls (turns) avg, search/rerank = 1 call per query, summary = 1 call per doc: (numbers are incremental cost impact under Optimized Pilot)
- Chat session (avg 100 tokens/request, 3 turns): ~0.3M tokens/session => ~$7.20 / session
- Search / rerank (single query, 1.2k tokens avg for context + rerank): ~0.0012M tokens => ~$0.029 / query (note: embeddings cost modeled separately)
- Summary (long doc generation, 1.5k tokens): ~0.0015M tokens => ~$0.036 / summary

Embeddings (one-time ingest) estimates:
- Batch embed (10M vectors): pricing varies by vector size and batching; estimated incremental service cost ~ $0.18 / 1k embeddings under Optimized Pilot (we’ll provide precise vector-size assumptions).

Margin / CAC payback quick example (assumptions):
- ARPU per customer for paid feature bundle: $350/mo
- Contribution margin target: 65% after inference costs
- If average inference cost per customer (chat+search avg usage) = $40/mo, then gross margin = (350 - 40) / 350 = 88.6% (well above target) — but this is sensitive to $/1M assumptions and caching hit-rate.
- CAC payback: with $350 ARPU, a CAC of $2,800 gives 8 months payback (2,800 / 350 = 8). With margin buffer, finance target <9 months is achievable if inference cost stays near the Optimized Pilot numbers.

Answers to Jorge’s explicit Qs:
1) Per-feature numbers above are under Optimized Pilot. Under Hosted baseline multiply each cost by ratio (Hosted / Optimized ~ 68/24 ≈ 2.8x) — we’ll add explicit hosted numbers in the workbook.
2) 12mo reserved Dedicated: expected delta is ~ $32 / 1M tokens improvement vs hosted (see numbers above). Latency SLOs: dedicated pools target p50 < 120ms token gen for the targeted model family, p95 depends on sequence length but we’ll share model-specific profiles.

Requested next steps:
- Jorge: confirm you want the workbook populated with the exact token assumptions (I’ll use 90/120 session sensitivity unless you tell me otherwise).
- Logan/Vivek: can you prepare a 4-week pilot quote with a $15k refundable credit and the Optimized Pilot profile (we aim for $24/1M)? Put an option for a 12mo Dedicated quote as well.
- Finance@acmetech: if you want a one-page CFO memo, we’ll produce a margin table and CAC payback scenarios.

We’ll circle back with a filled spreadsheet and a short call next week to finalize pilot terms. Thanks all — looking forward to moving to pilot.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
